new_claims: For centered field vectors, Hamming weight is at most squared l2 norm.
A GapMDP source with honest centered amplitude B converts a Hamming gap gamma into Euclidean gap sqrt(gamma)/B.
A supplied codeword of l2 norm at most B*sqrt(d) has support at most B^2*d, so a source extractor through that threshold yields the original witness.
Any nonzero linear symbol encoder F_p -> F_p^L has worst-case centered Linf amplitude (p-1)/2.
Canonical radix decoding has an explicit support-two kernel, and homogeneous linear checks cannot enforce canonicality for every field symbol because valid power encodings span the full digit space.
